authority_invariant: The member runtime makes registered Penta systems addressable and operable without promoting their maturity or manufacturing authority.
execution_boundary: V1.5 member adapters are repository-local and provider-effect false. Readiness, observability, compliance, licensing, Scribe, Marketer, PentaEVIBuilder, and PentaImmune operations execute bounded internal logic only. License readiness never issues a grant; Scribe/Marketer previews never publish externally; evidence preview remains unverified; repair preview never executes a repair or promotes production.
promotion_rule: A member cannot be represented as execution-operational merely by registry maturity. Certified/production maturity plus at least one tested bounded adapter is mandatory, and provider-effect operations remain separately gated by PentaCertify, CHLOM/DAIL, PentaHybrid, credentials, readback and evidence.
